Unternehmensvorstellung

Bei McDonald’s ist jeder Tag eine neue Chance, zu wachsen, zu führen und gemeinsam etwas zu bewegen! Unser Team liebt es, zusammenzuarbeiten, sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen und unseren Gästen sowie der Crew tolle Momente zu schenken. Wenn du einen dynamischen Job mit echten Karrieremöglichkeiten suchst, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Assistant Restaurant Manager unterstützt du den Restaurant Manager bei der Führung des Teams und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf im Restaurant. Du übernimmst zusätzliche Aufgaben, setzt ein Vorbild bei Lebensmittelsicherheit, Qualität, Service und Hygiene und trägst zur Entwicklung des Restaurants bei. Du coachst und motivierst Teammitglieder, koordinierst Prioritäten und förderst ein positives, respektvolles Arbeitsklima.

Hauptaufgaben

• Führung des Teams mit Empathie, Respekt und Geduld

• Offene Kommunikation und konstruktives Konfliktmanagement

• Strategische Prioritäten setzen und tägliche Abläufe koordinieren

• Coaching und Unterstützung von Schichtleitern und Crew für optimale Leistung

• Sicherstellung von Standards bei Lebensmittelsicherheit, Qualität, Service, Sauberkeit und Hygiene

• Nutzung von Managementtools für Planung, Kassenführung, Bestellungen und Inventar

• Analyse von KPIs und Unterstützung von Entwicklungsinitiativen

• Unterstützung bei Rekrutierung, Onboarding, Schulung und Mitarbeiterbindung

• Bearbeitung von Beschwerden und Schaffung von Wohlfühlmomenten für Gäste

• Wartung der Ausrüstung und Fehlerbehebung

• Erfahrung in Teamleitung oder Gastronomie von Vorteil

• Starke Kommunikations- und Konfliktmanagementfähigkeiten

• Analytisch, organisiert und technikaffin

• Proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und lernbereit

• Zuverlässig, vertrauenswürdig und belastbar

Il nostro team ama lavorare insieme, supportarsi a vicenda e dare ai nostri ospiti e equipaggio grandi momenti. Se stai cercando un lavoro dinamico con opportunità di carriera reali, sei al posto giusto con noi!

Descrizione del lavoro

Come Assistant Restaurant Manager, supporta il Restaurant Manager nella guida del team e assicura che il ristorante funzioni senza problemi. Si occupa di compiti aggiuntivi, impostare un esempio in sicurezza alimentare, qualità, servizio e igiene e contribuire allo sviluppo del ristorante. Allena e motiva i membri del team, coordina le priorità e promuove un ambiente di lavoro positivo e rispettoso.

Principali compiti

• Guidare la squadra con empatia, rispetto e pazienza

• Comunicazione aperta e gestione dei conflitti costruttiva

• Impostare priorità strategiche e coordinare i processi quotidiani

• Allenamento e supporto dei turnisti e dell'equipaggio per prestazioni ottimali

• Garantire sicurezza alimentare, qualità, servizio, pulizia e igiene

• Utilizzo di strumenti di gestione per la pianificazione, la gestione dei contanti, gli ordini e l'inventario

• Analisi dei KPI e sostegno alle iniziative di sviluppo

• Sostegno al reclutamento, all'imbarco, alla formazione e alla fidelizzazione dei dipendenti

• Gestire reclami e creare momenti di benessere per gli ospiti

• Manutenzione e risoluzione dei problemi
Requisiti

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione dei conflitti

• Analitico, organizzato e tech-savvy

• Proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e pronto ad imparare

• Affidabile, affidabile e resiliente

• Buona conoscenza della lingua nazionale (verbale e scritta)

As Assistant Restaurant Manager, you support the Restaurant Manager in leading the team and ensuring that the restaurant runs smoothly. You take on additional tasks, set an example in food safety, quality, service and hygiene and contribute to the development of the restaurant. jobs.description:
Job Description: McDonald’s, the world’s largest restaurant chain, is an innovative and people - oriented company backed by a leading multinational brand. As our business continues to grow, we are looking for talented individuals to strengthen our head offices, which support our restaurants across the country. To complement its Technology Department based in Crissier, McDonald’s Switzerland is looking to fill the role of:

IT Operations & Technology Intern (100%) to join our team for a 6-month internship . This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who is passionate about technology and eager to gain hands-on experience within a large international company.

No prior professional experience is required. What matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn, positive attitude, and readiness to roll up your sleeves and contribute wherever needed. During the internship, you will work closely with both our RUN team (responsible for daily operations and support) and our BUILD team (responsible for projects and technology deployments), giving you exposure to a wide range of technologies, business processes, and IT disciplines.

IT Operations Support

• Support the RUN team with daily activities and administrative tasks

• Use existing tools and scripts to support business and restaurant operations

• Assist with data management and operational reporting activities

Project & Deployment Support

• Support the BUILD team in preparing and coordinating technology deployments

• Assist with the preparation and maintenance of the IT laboratory environment

• Prepare systems and equipment required for software promotions, pilot programs, and testing activities

Testing & Quality Assurance

• Perform functional testing of new software releases and technology solutions

• Document test results and help track identified issues

• Support user acceptance testing and pilot activities

Documentation & Process Improvement

• Create and maintain internal and external support documentation

• Develop and improve operational workflows and support procedures

• Help build knowledge base articles and user guides

Team & Business Support

• Assist the IT Leadership Team with various operational and administrative requests

• Help organize internal meetings, events, workshops, and team activities

• Collaborate with internal teams, suppliers, and support partners

Experience & Knowledge

Essential

• Recently completed or currently completing a diploma in Information Technology (Bsc or Msc degree in IT, CFC Informatique, Brevet Fédéral d’Informaticien or equivalent IT qualification)

• Strong interest in technology and desire to build a career in IT

• Good communication and teamwork skills

• Proactive attitude and willingness to learn

• Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities

• Fluent in French and/or English

Highly Valued

• Any hands-on experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Intune, Windows environments, and IT support activities

• Basic scripting knowledge (PowerShell or similar)

• Understanding of basic networking concepts (DHCP, DNS, VLAN, IP addressing) and IT troubleshooting principles

• Previous internship, student project, or personal technology projects

• Interest in restaurant technology, retail, or operational environments

With Us, You Get the Following Benefits

• Flexible working: flexible hours and the possibility to work remotely based on business needs.

• Learning & development: access to local and international training opportunities, including Hamburger University.

• Well-being: contributions to wellness activities and employee support initiatives.

• Restaurant discounts : attractive discounts in our restaurants.

• Corporate Benefits: exclusive offers and discounts through our partner platforms

• Assistere con la preparazione e la manutenzione dell'ambiente di laboratorio IT

Test e garanzia di qualità

• Supporta test di accettazione degli utenti e attività pilota

• Sviluppare e migliorare i flussi di lavoro operativi e le procedure di supporto

Supporto per team & business

• Assistere il team IT Leadership con varie richieste operative e amministrative

• Aiuta a organizzare riunioni interne, eventi, workshop e attività di team

• Collabora con team interni, fornitori e partner di supporto

Esperienza e conoscenza

Essenziale

• Recentemente completato o attualmente completato un diploma in Information Technology (Bsc o Msc laurea in IT, CFC Informatique, Brevet Fédéral d’Informaticien o equivalente qualifica IT)

• Forte interesse per la tecnologia e il desiderio di costruire una carriera in IT

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra

• Atteggiamento attivo e volontà di imparare

• Lavoro confortevole in un ambiente dinamico con priorità in evoluzione

• Fluente in francese e/o inglese

Valore elevato

• Qualsiasi esperienza pratica con Active Directory, Microsoft Intune, ambienti Windows e attività di supporto IT

• Conoscenze di scrittura di base (PowerShell o simili)

• Comprensione dei concetti di rete di base (DHCP, DNS, VLAN, indirizzo IP) e dei principi di risoluzione dei problemi IT

• Precedente stage, progetto di studenti, o progetti di tecnologia personale

• Interessi nella tecnologia del ristorante, nella vendita al dettaglio o negli ambienti operativi

Con noi, ottieni i seguenti vantaggi

• Riduzioni ristorante: sconti interessanti nei nostri ristoranti.

jobs.title: Consultant Construction (100%)
jobs.description:
Job Description: McDonald’s, the world’s largest restaurant chain, is an innovative and people - oriented company backed by a leading multinational brand. As our business continues to grow, we are looking for talented individuals to strengthen our head offices, which support our restaurants across the country. To complement its Develoment Department based in Crissier, McDonald’s Switzerland is looking to fill the role of:

Consultant Construction (100%)

In this exciting role, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing the full permitting process for new store openings (NSO) as well as major renovation and reconstruction projects for McDonald’s Switzerland. You will ensure that all building permits are submitted and obtained in compliance with McDonald’s global standards and specifications.

Key responsabilities

• Lead the submission of building permit applications and ensure their timely approval in accordance with established processes

• Collaborate closely with architects, external partners, and internal stakeholders to secure required approvals

• Oversee the preparation of architectural plans and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements

• Manage and track all administrative aspects of ongoing permitting procedures

• Monitor construction progress to ensure adherence to approved permits and specifications

• Track project budgets and review/validate invoices from architects and external experts

• Act as the primary point of contact for architects, site managers, and real estate representatives

• Work cross-functionally with both internal and external stakeholders to ensure project success

• Organize your work with strong attention to detail and a results-driven mindset

Your Profile

• Education: Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Architecture, or Interior Architecture; alternatively, a Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or Interior Architecture

• Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in construction project management (as an engineer, project manager, or architect)

• Languages: Native German speaker with excellent command of English and/or French

• Project Management: Proven ability to independently manage projects from initiation to completion

• Interpersonal Skills: Strong negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities

• Communication: Confident presenter with the ability to influence and drive decisions

• Personal Attributes: Agile, flexible, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment; autonomous while maintaining a collaborative mindset

• Tools: Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and project management platforms (e.g., Smartsheet)
 With Us, You Get the Following Benefits

• Flexible working: flexible hours and the possibility to work remotely based on business needs.

• Mobility benefit: company car, SBB travel pass, or travel allowance depending on the position package.

• Bonus: variable compensation linked to individual and business performance.

• Learning & development: access to local and international training opportunities, including Hamburger University.

As our business continues to grow, we are looking for talented individuals to strengthen our head offices, which support our restaurants across the country. To complement its People Department based in Crissier, McDonald’s Switzerland is looking to fill the role of:

HR Business Partner (80-100%)

We are looking for an HR professional to join our People Team and serve as a trusted partner to franchisees, restaurant leadership teams, and internal stakeholders across German-speaking Switzerland . In this key role, you will contribute to the implementation of McDonald’s HR strategy, drive People initiatives, and help deliver an outstanding employee experience throughout the region.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as a trusted HR partner for franchisees, restaurant leadership teams, and Operations stakeholders, providing guidance on employee relations, talent development, performance management, compliance, and HR administration.

• Drive the implementation of McDonald’s HR strategy and key People initiatives across the restaurant organization.

• Analyze HR metrics and workforce trends to identify opportunities, support decision-making, and address organizational needs.

• Lead and contribute to local and national HR projects, ensuring effective execution, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of business objectives.

• Support the resolution of complex employee relations matters and promote a positive and compliant work environment.

• Ensure HR policies, procedures, and documentation remain up to date and aligned with legal and business requirements.

• Deliver training, share best practices, and contribute to the continuous development of people capabilities across the restaurant network.

What You Need to Be Successful

• University degree or equivalent qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of significant experience in a similar HR Business Partner or HR Consultant, ideally in a multi-site and fast-paced environment.

• Strong knowledge of Swiss labor law and HR best practices, combined with proven experience advising leaders, managing employee relations matters, and driving HR projects and initiatives.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted partnerships across all levels of the organization.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, coupled with a pragmatic, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset.

• Native German speaker with professional proficiency in English; French and/or Italian are strong assets.

• Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland to support restaurants and business stakeholders.

• Flexible working: flexible hours and the possibility to work remotely based on business needs.

Questo ruolo funge da ponte chiave tra le operazioni del ristorante, i partner esterni di supporto e i team IT interni, garantendo prestazioni tecnologiche affidabili in tutta la tenuta. Questo non è un ruolo tecnico puro, ma richiede una forte mentalità operativa, una buona base in IT, e un'elevata disponibilità ad imparare e crescere in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

Tecnologia consultiva (100%)

Area di responsabilità

Tecnologia ristorante & supporto

• Atto come supporto di livello 3 per le tecnologie del ristorante, con una forte attenzione su:
• Sistemi Point-of-sale (POS) utilizzati nei ristoranti

• Sistemi di back-office utilizzati per la gestione del ristorante (ad esempio inventario, reporting, strumenti di configurazione)

• Gestire e gestire complessi escalation da ristoranti e partner di supporto attraverso la risoluzione

• Eseguire l'analisi delle cause root e definire azioni correttive sostenibili

Gestione e abilitazione dei partner

• Fornitori di servizi esterni (ad esempio, partner di servizio sul campo, banchi di assistenza)

• Assicurarsi che i partner siano attrezzati per fornire un supporto costante e di alta qualità ai ristoranti

• Definire e mantenere i quadri di certificazione che delineano le conoscenze e le competenze necessarie per i partner di supporto

Gestione delle conoscenze e dei processi

• Mantenere e migliorare continuamente la base di conoscenza utilizzata dai partner di supporto

• Standardizzare e documentare i processi di supporto, la risoluzione dei problemi e le procedure operative

• Miglioramento dell'esperienza di supporto del ristorante, comprese le capacità di self-service

Operazioni e gestione degli incidenti

• Assicurare una gestione efficace dei principali incidenti e situazioni business-critical impatto ristoranti

• Monitorare le prestazioni del servizio e identificare le aree di miglioramento

• Applicare le migliori pratiche in caso di incidente, problemi e gestione dell'escalation

Stakeholder Engagement

• Agire come interfaccia chiave tra le operazioni di ristorante, team IT e partner di supporto

• Traduci argomenti tecnici in comunicazione chiara e fattibile per il pubblico non tecnico

Esperienza e conoscenza

Essenziale

• ~5 anni di esperienza in IT, supporto tecnologico, o un campo correlato

• Solido generale IT conoscenza e forte risolvere i problemi mindset

• Capacità di analisi con la capacità di fornire una visione “grande-immagine” e di cogliere i dettagli del livello del terreno, se necessario.

• Competenze di comunicazione eccellenti con stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici

• Capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico

• Alta motivazione per imparare rapidamente e sviluppare competenze tecniche

• Inglese (Written and Verbal), Francese o Tedesco (Written and Verbal), Facoltativamente italiano (Written and Verbal)

Valore elevato

• Esperienza nelle operazioni del ristorante, nel retail o in ambienti di ospitalità

• Esperienza di supporto sistemi POS o applicazioni operative business-critical

• Esperienza di lavoro con fornitori di servizi esterni o organizzazioni di supporto

Conoscenza e competenze tecniche (Buona base prevista)

Buona comprensione di:

• Dispositivi e periferiche dell'utente finale

• Ambienti Windows

• Fondamenti di rete (DNS, DHCP, VLAN, ecc.)

• Principi fondamentali della directory attiva (tutti gli oggetti, GPO, sicurezza)

• Fondamenti di gestione dei servizi IT (incidente, escalation, gestione dei problemi)

• Concetti di scrittura di base e amministrazione di sistema:
• Comprensione ed esecuzione delle operazioni PowerShell e riga di comando

• Utilizzando comandi standard (ad esempio controlli di servizio, query di sistema, riavviamento del dispositivo)

• Familiarità con gli strumenti di pianificazione delle attività (ad esempio Windows Task Scheduler o simili)

Sensibilizzazione generale:

• Principi di sicurezza e protezione endpoint

• Sistemi operativi (Windows 10 e 11, Windows 10 LTSB)

• Metodologia DevOps

• Principi di ITIL

McDonald's offre ai propri dipendenti un ambiente di lavoro attraente, dinamico e diversificato basato sul lavoro di squadra, il riconoscimento di prestazioni eccezionali e formazione. • Beneficio di mobilità: automobile aziendale, pass di viaggio FFS, o indennità di viaggio a seconda del pacchetto di posizione.

Das McDonald’s Switzerland IT Operations Team ist für den Einsatz und Betrieb von Restaurant- und Unternehmenstechnologie in der ganzen Schweiz verantwortlich. Unser Angebot umfasst Point-of-Sale-Systeme, Back-Office-Anwendungen, digitale Lösungen und hochverfügbare Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung des Restaurantbetriebs. Wir suchen einen Technologieberater, um unsere Restaurant-orientierten Aktivitäten zu stärken. Diese Rolle ist eine wichtige Brücke zwischen Restaurantbetrieb, externen Supportpartnern und internen IT-Teams und gewährleistet eine zuverlässige Technologieleistung im gesamten Anwesen. Dies ist keine reine technische Rolle, sondern erfordert eine starke betriebliche Denkweise, eine gute Grundlage in der IT und eine hohe Bereitschaft, in einer sich schnell entwickelnden Umgebung zu lernen und zu wachsen.

Beratertechnologie (100%)

Zuständigkeitsbereich

Restauranttechnik & Support

• Als Level 3-Unterstützung für Restaurant-Technologien fungieren, mit einem starken Fokus auf:
• Kassensysteme in Restaurants

• Back-Office-Systeme für das Restaurantmanagement (z. B. Inventar, Reporting, Konfigurationstools)

• Besitzen und verwalten Sie komplexe Eskalationen von Restaurants und Support-Partnern bis hin zur Lösung

• Führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch und definieren Sie nachhaltige Korrekturmaßnahmen

Partner Management & Enablement

• Zug, Führung und Unterstützung externer Dienstleister (z.B. Außendienstpartner, Service Desks)

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Partner gerüstet sind, um Restaurants qualitativ hochwertige, konsistente Unterstützung zu bieten

• Definieren und pflegen Sie Zertifizierungs-Frameworks, die die erforderlichen Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten für Support-Partner umreißen

Wissens- und Prozessmanagement

• Pflege und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der von Support-Partnern genutzten Wissensbasis

• Standardisieren und Dokumentieren von Supportprozessen, Fehlerbehebungsschritten und Betriebsverfahren

• Verbesserung der Restaurant-Support-Erfahrung, einschließlich Self-Service-Funktionen

Operations & Incident Management

• Gewährleistung eines effektiven Umgangs mit schweren Vorfällen und geschäftskritischen Situationen, die sich auf Restaurants auswirken

• Überwachung der Serviceleistung und Identifizierung von Verbesserungsbereichen

• Best Practices im Incident-, Problem- und Eskalationsmanagement anwenden

Engagement der Interessenträger

• Handeln Sie als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Restaurantbetrieb, IT-Teams und Supportpartnern

• Übersetzen Sie technische Themen in eine klare, umsetzbare Kommunikation für nicht-technische Zielgruppen

Erfahrung & Wissen

Wesentliches

• ~5 Jahre Erfahrung in IT, Technologie-Support oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Solides allgemeines IT-Wissen und starkes Troubleshooting Mindset

• Fähige Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, eine "Big-Picture" -Ansicht zu bieten und erforderlichenfalls Bodendetails zu erfassen

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu verwalten

• Hohe Motivation schnell zu lernen und technisches Know-how zu entwickeln

• Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich), Französisch oder Deutsch (schriftlich und mündlich), optional Italienisch (schriftlich und mündlich)

Hochwertig

• Erfahrung im Restaurantbetrieb, im Einzelhandel oder im Gastgewerbe

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von POS-Systemen oder geschäftskritischen Betriebsanwendungen

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern oder Supportorganisationen

Technisches Wissen & Fähigkeiten (gute Grundlage erwartet)

Gutes Verständnis von:

• Endbenutzergeräte und Peripheriegeräte

• Windows-Umgebungen

• Grundlagen der Vernetzung (DNS, DHCP, VLANs usw.)

• Active Directory-Grundlagen (alle Objekte, GPO, Sicherheit)

• IT Service Management Grundlagen (Incident, Eskalation, Problemmanagement)

• Grundlegende Skript- und Systemadministrationskonzepte:
• Verstehen und Ausführen von PowerShell- und Kommandozeilenoperationen

• Verwendung von Standardbefehlen (z. B. Service Checks, Systemabfragen, Geräteneustarts)

• Vertrautheit mit Task Scheduling Tools (z. B. Windows Task Scheduler oder ähnliches)

Allgemeiner Kenntnisstand über

• Sicherheitsgrundsätze und Endpunktschutz

• Betriebssysteme (Windows 10 und 11, Windows 10 LTSB)

• DevOps-Methodik

• ITIL-Grundsätze

Description de l'emploi : L'équipe des opérations informatiques McDonaldS Suisse est responsable du déploiement et de l'exploitation de la technologie des restaurants et des entreprises en Suisse. Notre champ d'application comprend les systèmes de point de vente, les applications back-office, les solutions numériques et l'infrastructure hautement disponible pour les opérations de restauration. Nous cherchons un consultant en technologie pour renforcer nos activités axées sur les restaurants. Ce rôle sert de pont clé entre les opérations de restauration, les partenaires de soutien externes et les équipes internes de TI, assurant ainsi une performance technologique fiable dans l'ensemble du domaine. Il ne s'agit pas d'un rôle purement technique, mais d'un état d'esprit opérationnel fort, d'une bonne base en TI et d'une forte volonté d'apprendre et de grandir dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

Consultant en technologie (100 %)

Domaine de responsabilité

Technologie et soutien des restaurants

• Agir comme support de niveau 3 pour les technologies de restauration, en mettant fortement l'accent sur:
• Systèmes de point de vente (POS) utilisés dans les restaurants

• Systèmes de back-office utilisés pour la gestion des restaurants (p. ex. inventaire, rapports, outils de configuration)

• Posséder et gérer des escalades complexes des restaurants et soutenir les partenaires jusqu'à la résolution

• Améliorer l'expérience de soutien au restaurant, y compris les capacités en libre-service

Opérations et gestion des incidents

• Excellentes compétences en communication avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique

• Expérience à l'appui des systèmes POS ou des applications opérationnelles critiques pour l'entreprise

• Expérience de travail avec des fournisseurs de services externes ou des organismes de soutien

jobs.description:
Job Description: McDonald’s, the world’s largest restaurant chain, is an innovative and people - oriented company backed by a leading multinational brand. As our business continues to grow, we are looking for talented individuals to strengthen our head offices, which support our restaurants across the country. To complement its Business Support Team based in Crissier, McDonald’s Switzerland is looking to fill
 the role of:

Coordinator Business Support (50%)

Your Mission
 In this role , you will be part of the McDonald’s Switzerland Business Support Team , a key team supporting multiple departments and managers on a daily basis. In this role, you will contribute to the smooth running of administrative and organizational activities by providing reliable, proactive, and high - quality support. You will work cl osely with other assistants and act in a transversal role depending on business needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide administrative support to the Marketing department as well as other teams as needed

• Manage calendars, organize meetings, visits, and events, including all related logistics

• Maintain and update internal tools and databases, ensuring data quality and confidentiality

• Follow up on various administrative topics and contribute to process improvements

• Ensure administrative follow - up of Marketing budgets in collaboration with the fiduciary

Lavoro a tempo parziale

Presentazione aziendale

A McDonald’s, creiamo un posto di lavoro dove tutti si sentono benvenuti, apprezzati e ispirati. Diventa parte di un team che celebra l'individualità, promuove la crescita e rende ogni giorno speciale. Se siete appassionati di rendere le persone felici e alla ricerca di un lavoro che si adatta alla vostra vita, siete al posto giusto!

Descrizione del lavoro

Come membro dell'equipaggio, siete nel cuore del nostro ristorante. Lavorate con grandi colleghi, servite i nostri ospiti con un sorriso e regalate momenti indimenticabili. Sia al bancone, in cucina o in squadra – la vostra energia e il vostro entusiasmo fanno la differenza.

Principali compiti

• Servizio amichevole ed efficiente per i nostri ospiti

• Preparazione e distribuzione di deliziosi cibi e bevande

• Collaborazione nel team per raggiungere gli obiettivi

• Creare un'atmosfera pulita e accogliente

• Flessibilità e atteggiamento positivo anche nei tempi frenetici
Requisiti

• Passione per rendere felici le persone

• Spirito di squadra e affidabilità

• Volontà di imparare e sviluppare

• Energia ed entusiasmo per un ambiente dinamico

• Nessuna conoscenza precedente necessaria – la motivazione conta!
Vantaggi

• Ore lavorative flessibili per un buon equilibrio di vita lavorativa

• Diverse attività in servizio, cucina e contatore – noia esclusa

• Team di supporto e opportunità di imparare per la vita e la carriera

• Remunerazione e condizioni di lavoro secondo le disposizioni del contratto collettivo di lavoro (L-GAV)

• 50% di sconto sui nostri prodotti nei nostri ristoranti in Svizzera e Liechtenstein

• Abbonamenti Sunrise ad un prezzo ridotto

• Accesso agli sconti esclusivi tramite la piattaforma "Corporate Benefits"

• Vacanze aggiuntive offerte per oltre 50s

• Accesso gratuito alla più grande biblioteca di formazione online
Applicazione

Pronto per la nostra squadra? Applicare ora e iniziare il vostro viaggio al McDonald’s! Non vediamo l'ora di vederti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Part-time job

Company presentation

At McDonald’s, we create a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and inspired. Become part of a team that celebrates individuality, promotes growth and makes every day special. If you are passionate about making people happy and looking for a job that fits your life, you are at the right place!

Job description

As a crew member, you are at the heart of our restaurant. You work with great colleagues, serve our guests with a smile and provide unforgettable moments. Whether at the counter, in the kitchen or in the team – your energy and enthusiasm make the difference.

Main tasks

• Friendly and efficient service for our guests

• Preparation and distribution of delicious food and drinks

• Collaboration in the team to achieve goals

• Creating a clean and welcoming atmosphere

• Flexibility and positive attitude even in hectic times
Requirements

• Passion for making people happy

• Team spirit and reliability

• Willingness to learn and develop

• Energy and enthusiasm for a dynamic environment

• No previous knowledge required – motivation counts!
Benefits

• Flexible working hours for a good work-life balance

• Diverse tasks in service, kitchen and counter – boredom excluded

• Supportive team and opportunities to learn for life and career

• Remuneration and working conditions in accordance with the provisions of the collective employment contract (L-GAV)

• 50% discount on our products in our restaurants in Switzerland and Liechtenstein

• Sunrise subscriptions at a reduced price

• Access to exclusive discounts via the "Corporate Benefits" platform

• Additional holidays offered for over 50s

• Free access to the largest online training library
Application

Ready for our team? Apply now and start your journey at McDonald’s! We look forward to seeing you.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Teilzeit Job

Unternehmensvorstellung

Bei McDonald’s schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem sich alle willkommen, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Individualität feiert, Wachstum fördert und jeden Tag besonders macht. Wenn du leidenschaftlich gerne Menschen glücklich machst und einen Job suchst, der zu deinem Leben passt, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Crew-Mitglied bist du das Herzstück unseres Restaurants. Du arbeitest mit tollen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, bedienst unsere Gäste mit einem Lächeln und sorgst für unvergessliche Momente. Ob am Counter, in der Küche oder im Team – deine Energie und Begeisterung machen den Unterschied.

Hauptaufgaben

• Freundlicher und effizienter Service für unsere Gäste

• Zubereitung und Ausgabe von leckeren Speisen und Getränken

• Zusammenarbeit im Team zur Zielerreichung

• Saubere und einladende Atmosphäre schaffen

• Flexibilität und positive Einstellung auch in hektischen Zeiten
Anforderungen

• Leidenschaft, Menschen glücklich zu machen

• Teamgeist und Zuverlässigkeit

• Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen und sich weiterzuentwickeln

• Energie und Begeisterung für ein dynamisches Umfeld

• Keine Vorkenntnisse erforderlich – Motivation zählt!
Vorteile

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine gute Work‑Life‑Balance

• Vielfältige Aufgaben in Service, Küche und Theke – Langeweile ausgeschlossen

• Unterstützendes Team und Möglichkeiten, fürs Leben und die Karriere zu lernen

• Vergütung und Arbeitsbedingungen gemäss den Bestimmungen des Gesamtarbeitsvertrags (L-GAV)

• 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unseren Restaurants in der Schweiz und in Liechtenstein

• Sunrise-Abos zu einem reduzierten Preis

• Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten über die Plattform "Corporate Benefits"

• Zusätzliche angebotene Ferien für über 50-Jährige

• Kostenloser Zugang zur grössten Online-Schulungsbibliothek
Bewerbung

Bereit für unser Team? Bewirb dich jetzt und starte deine Reise bei McDonald’s! Wir freuen uns auf dich.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Emploi à temps partiel

Présentation de l'entreprise

Chez McDonald, nous créons un milieu de travail où tout le monde se sent bienvenu, apprécié et inspiré. Faites partie d'une équipe qui célèbre l'individualité, favorise la croissance et rend chaque jour spécial. Si vous êtes passionné de rendre les gens heureux et de chercher un emploi qui convient à votre vie, vous êtes au bon endroit!

Description du poste

En tant que membre d'équipage, vous êtes au cœur de notre restaurant. Vous travaillez avec de grands collègues, servez nos invités avec un sourire et offrez des moments inoubliables. Que ce soit au comptoir, dans la cuisine ou en équipe, votre énergie et votre enthousiasme font la différence.

Principales tâches

• Service amical et efficace pour nos clients

• Préparation et distribution de délicieux aliments et boissons

• Collaboration au sein de l'équipe pour atteindre les objectifs

• Créer une atmosphère propre et accueillante

• Souplesse et attitude positive, même en période agitée
Exigences

• Passion pour rendre les gens heureux

• Esprit d'équipe et fiabilité

• Volonté d'apprendre et de développer

• Énergie et enthousiasme pour un environnement dynamique

• Aucune connaissance préalable requise – la motivation compte!
Avantages

• Des horaires flexibles pour un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée

• Diverses tâches en service, cuisine et comptoir – ennui exclu

• Équipe de soutien et possibilités d'apprendre pour la vie et la carrière

• Rémunération et conditions de travail conformément aux dispositions du contrat de travail collectif (L-GAV)

• Remise de 50% sur nos produits dans nos restaurants en Suisse et au Liechtenstein

• Abonnements Sunrise à un prix réduit

• Accès à des rabais exclusifs via la plate-forme « Avantages corporatifs »

• Vacances supplémentaires offertes pour plus de 50 ans

• Accès gratuit à la plus grande bibliothèque de formation en ligne
Demande

Prêt pour notre équipe ? Faites votre demande dès maintenant et commencez votre voyage chez McDonald! Nous avons hâte de vous voir.

Diventa parte di un team che celebra l'individualità, promuove la crescita e rende ogni giorno speciale. Se siete appassionati di rendere le persone felici e alla ricerca di un lavoro che si adatta alla vostra vita, siete al posto giusto!

Come membro dell'equipaggio, siete nel cuore del nostro ristorante. Lavorate con grandi colleghi, servite i nostri ospiti con un sorriso e regalate momenti indimenticabili. Sia al bancone, in cucina o in squadra – la vostra energia e il vostro entusiasmo fanno la differenza.

Principali compiti

• Servizio amichevole ed efficiente per i nostri ospiti

• Preparazione e distribuzione di deliziosi cibi e bevande

• Collaborazione nel team per raggiungere gli obiettivi

• Creare un'atmosfera pulita e accogliente

• Flessibilità e atteggiamento positivo anche nei tempi frenetici
Requisiti

• Passione per rendere felici le persone

• Spirito di squadra e affidabilità

• Volontà di imparare e sviluppare

• Energia ed entusiasmo per un ambiente dinamico

• Nessuna conoscenza precedente necessaria – la motivazione conta!
Vantaggi

• Ore lavorative flessibili per un buon equilibrio di vita lavorativa

• Diverse attività in servizio, cucina e contatore – noia esclusa

• Team di supporto e opportunità di imparare per la vita e la carriera

• Remunerazione e condizioni di lavoro secondo le disposizioni del contratto collettivo di lavoro (L-GAV)

• 50% di sconto sui nostri prodotti nei nostri ristoranti in Svizzera e Liechtenstein

• Abbonamenti Sunrise ad un prezzo ridotto

• Accesso agli sconti esclusivi tramite la piattaforma "Corporate Benefits"

• Vacanze aggiuntive offerte per oltre 50s

• Accesso gratuito alla più grande biblioteca di formazione online

Presentazione aziendale

Diventa parte di un team che celebra l'individualità, promuove la crescita e rende ogni giorno speciale. Descrizione del lavoro

Come membro dell'equipaggio, siete nel cuore del nostro ristorante. Lavorate con grandi colleghi, servite i nostri ospiti con un sorriso e regalate momenti indimenticabili. Sia al bancone, in cucina o in squadra – la vostra energia e il vostro entusiasmo fanno la differenza.

• Servizio amichevole ed efficiente per i nostri ospiti

• Preparazione e distribuzione di deliziosi cibi e bevande

• Flessibilità e atteggiamento positivo anche nei tempi frenetici
 Requisiti

• Passione per rendere felici le persone

• Spirito di squadra e affidabilità

descriptionByLocale.en:
Company presentation

At McDonald’s, we create a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and inspired. Become part of a team that celebrates individuality, promotes growth and makes every day special. If you are passionate about making people happy and looking for a job that fits your life, you are at the right place!

Job description

As a crew member, you are at the heart of our restaurant. You work with great colleagues, serve our guests with a smile and provide unforgettable moments. Whether at the counter, in the kitchen or in the team – your energy and enthusiasm make the difference.

Main tasks

• Friendly and efficient service for our guests

• Preparation and distribution of delicious food and drinks

• Collaboration in the team to achieve goals

• Creating a clean and welcoming atmosphere

• Flexibility and positive attitude even in hectic times
 Requirements

• Passion for making people happy

• Team spirit and reliability

• Willingness to learn and develop

• Energy and enthusiasm for a dynamic environment

• No previous knowledge required – motivation counts!
 Benefits

• Flexible working hours for a good work-life balance

• Diverse tasks in service, kitchen and counter – boredom excluded

• Supportive team and opportunities to learn for life and career

• Remuneration and working conditions in accordance with the provisions of the collective employment contract (L-GAV)

• 50% discount on our products in our restaurants in Switzerland and Liechtenstein

• Sunrise subscriptions at a reduced price

• Access to exclusive discounts via the "Corporate Benefits" platform

• Additional holidays offered for over 50s

• Free access to the largest online training library
 Application

Ready for our team? Apply now and start your journey at McDonald’s! We look forward to seeing you.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation de l'entreprise

Chez McDonald, nous créons un milieu de travail où tout le monde se sent bienvenu, apprécié et inspiré. Faites partie d'une équipe qui célèbre l'individualité, favorise la croissance et rend chaque jour spécial. Si vous êtes passionné de rendre les gens heureux et de chercher un emploi qui convient à votre vie, vous êtes au bon endroit!

Description du poste

En tant que membre d'équipage, vous êtes au cœur de notre restaurant. Vous travaillez avec de grands collègues, servez nos invités avec un sourire et offrez des moments inoubliables. Que ce soit au comptoir, dans la cuisine ou en équipe, votre énergie et votre enthousiasme font la différence.

Principales tâches

• Service amical et efficace pour nos clients

• Préparation et distribution de délicieux aliments et boissons

• Collaboration au sein de l'équipe pour atteindre les objectifs

• Créer une atmosphère propre et accueillante

• Souplesse et attitude positive, même en période agitée
 Exigences

• Passion pour rendre les gens heureux

• Esprit d'équipe et fiabilité

• Volonté d'apprendre et de développer

• Énergie et enthousiasme pour un environnement dynamique

• Aucune connaissance préalable requise – la motivation compte!
 Avantages

• Des horaires flexibles pour un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée

• Diverses tâches en service, cuisine et comptoir – ennui exclu

• Équipe de soutien et possibilités d'apprendre pour la vie et la carrière

• Rémunération et conditions de travail conformément aux dispositions du contrat de travail collectif (L-GAV)

• Remise de 50% sur nos produits dans nos restaurants en Suisse et au Liechtenstein

• Abonnements Sunrise à un prix réduit

• Accès à des rabais exclusifs via la plate-forme « Avantages corporatifs »

• Vacances supplémentaires offertes pour plus de 50 ans

• Accès gratuit à la plus grande bibliothèque de formation en ligne
 Demande

Prêt pour notre équipe ? Faites votre demande dès maintenant et commencez votre voyage chez McDonald! Nous avons hâte de vous voir.

Faites partie d'une équipe qui célèbre l'individualité, favorise la croissance et rend chaque jour spécial. Si vous êtes passionné de rendre les gens heureux et de chercher un emploi qui convient à votre vie, vous êtes au bon endroit!

Description du poste

En tant que membre d'équipage, vous êtes au cœur de notre restaurant. Vous travaillez avec de grands collègues, servez nos invités avec un sourire et offrez des moments inoubliables. Que ce soit au comptoir, dans la cuisine ou en équipe, votre énergie et votre enthousiasme font la différence.

Principales tâches

• Service amical et efficace pour nos clients

• Préparation et distribution de délicieux aliments et boissons

• Collaboration au sein de l'équipe pour atteindre les objectifs

• Créer une atmosphère propre et accueillante

• Souplesse et attitude positive, même en période agitée
Exigences

• Passion pour rendre les gens heureux

• Esprit d'équipe et fiabilité

• Volonté d'apprendre et de développer

• Énergie et enthousiasme pour un environnement dynamique

• Aucune connaissance préalable requise – la motivation compte!

• Des horaires flexibles pour un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée

• Diverses tâches en service, cuisine et comptoir – ennui exclu

• Équipe de soutien et possibilités d'apprendre pour la vie et la carrière

• Rémunération et conditions de travail conformément aux dispositions du contrat de travail collectif (L-GAV)

• Remise de 50% sur nos produits dans nos restaurants en Suisse et au Liechtenstein

• Abonnements Sunrise à un prix réduit

• Accès à des rabais exclusifs via la plate-forme « Avantages corporatifs »

• Vacances supplémentaires offertes pour plus de 50 ans

• Accès gratuit à la plus grande bibliothèque de formation en ligne

La formazione EFZ è una formazione triennale mirata a persone motivate ad ottenere una visione olistica della professione, ad assumersi gradualmente la responsabilità e a svilupparsi a lungo termine nella ristorazione di sistema.

• Pianificazione del lavoro e organizzazione del team

• Le basi di marketing e soddisfazione dei clienti

• Principi di gestione del personale

• Pratica formazione direttamente nel ristorante

• Corsi intercompany per collegare teoria e pratica

descriptionByLocale.en:
Apprentices in system gastronomy EFZ

Our goal: to train young people!

We are looking for an apprentice for our restaurant as a system catering specialist EFZ.

The EFZ training is a three-year training aimed at people who are motivated to gain a holistic view of the profession, to gradually assume responsibility and to develop in the long term in system catering.

Profile

• This teaching is made for you if:

• You have completed secondary school

• You have basic knowledge of German (in word and writing)

• You like practical and manual work

• You enjoy working in a team and having customer contact

• You are reliable, punctual and willing to learn

• You like to follow clear guidelines and procedures

• You are stress resistant and feel comfortable in a dynamic environment

• Order, cleanliness and hygiene are among your priorities
Your future profession

As a system gastronomy EFZ learner, you will receive a comprehensive and varied education that combines practical practice with in-depth theoretical knowledge.

Among other things, you will learn:

• Preparation of products and customer service according to high quality standards

• Organize work and work together effectively in a team

• Understanding and applying restaurant work processes

• Quality assurance, hygiene and safety

• Gradually take on more responsibility in different positions
As your education progresses, you will also be introduced to:

• Work planning and team organisation

• Cost control and resource management

• The Basics of Marketing and Customer Satisfaction

• Staff management principles
Your education

EFZ training lasts 3 years and includes:

• Practical training directly in the restaurant

• Courses in vocational school for deepening theoretical knowledge

• Intercompany courses for linking theory and practice
Your Federal Certificate of Competence (EFZ) is a solid foundation for your professional future at McDonald's or in catering.

Your development prospects

After your EFZ, you have many possibilities:

• Direct entry into the labour market

• Development towards leadership positions (management)

• Internal or external training

• Development opportunities in restaurants, the franchise organisation or in the Head Office in Crissier
What we offer you

• A recognised, demanding and valuable education

• A dynamic, structured and caring working environment

• Professional support and personal support throughout the learning process

• Experienced and dedicated trainers

• Real long-term development prospects
Interested?

Send us your complete application documents :

• Letter of motivation

• CVC

• 3 last year

• Where applicable, certificates or traineeship reports

Bei McDonald’s schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem sich alle willkommen, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Individualität feiert, Wachstum fördert und jeden Tag besonders macht. Wenn du leidenschaftlich gerne Menschen glücklich machst und einen Job suchst, der zu deinem Leben passt, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Crew-Mitglied bist du das Herzstück unseres Restaurants. Du arbeitest mit tollen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, bedienst unsere Gäste mit einem Lächeln und sorgst für unvergessliche Momente. Ob am Counter, in der Küche oder im Team – deine Energie und Begeisterung machen den Unterschied.

• Freundlicher und effizienter Service für unsere Gäste

• Zubereitung und Ausgabe von leckeren Speisen und Getränken

• Zusammenarbeit im Team zur Zielerreichung

• Saubere und einladende Atmosphäre schaffen

• Flexibilität und positive Einstellung auch in hektischen Zeiten
 Anforderungen

• Leidenschaft, Menschen glücklich zu machen

• Teamgeist und Zuverlässigkeit

• Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen und sich weiterzuentwickeln

• Energie und Begeisterung für ein dynamisches Umfeld

• Keine Vorkenntnisse erforderlich – Motivation zählt!
 Vorteile

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine gute Work‑Life‑Balance

• Vielfältige Aufgaben in Service, Küche und Theke – Langeweile ausgeschlossen

• Unterstützendes Team und Möglichkeiten, fürs Leben und die Karriere zu lernen

jobs.description:
Unternehmensvorstellung

Bei McDonald’s ist jede Schicht eine neue Chance, zu lernen, gemeinsam etwas zu bewegen und Spass zu haben! Unser Team liebt es, zusammenzuarbeiten, sich gegenseitig zu unterstützen und unseren Gästen sowie der Crew tolle Momente zu schenken. Wenn du einen Job suchst, der energiegeladen, sozial und voller Möglichkeiten ist, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Schichtkoordinator/in bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für dein Team und unsere Gäste. Du organisierst und leitest deine Schicht, sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf und dafür, dass sich alle wohl und sicher fühlen. Du motivierst deine Crew, packst überall mit an und bringst positive Energie in jede Schicht. Du gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran, achtest auf Lebensmittelsicherheit, Qualität, Service, Sauberkeit und Hygiene und bist immer bereit, dein Team zu coachen und zu unterstützen.

Hauptaufgaben

• Organisation und Leitung deiner Schicht für ein reibungsloses Restauranterlebnis

• Sicherstellung eines sicheren und einladenden Umfelds für Gäste und Team

• Einhaltung hoher Standards bei Qualität, Service, Sauberkeit und Hygiene

• Unterstützung des Teams in hektischen Momenten – ob in der Küche, an der Theke oder im Restaurant

• Förderung von Teamwork und Motivation der Crew

• Offene Kommunikation und Konfliktmanagement mit Empathie und Respekt

• Nutzung von Planungs- und Managementtools (Kassen, Bestellungen, Inventar)

• Unterstützung von Trainings- und Entwicklungsinitiativen

Anforderungen

• Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen und im Team

• Offene, empathische und respektvolle Kommunikation

• Proaktiv, einfallsreich und lernbereit

• Analytisch und technikaffin

• Belastbar, flexibel und optimistisch

• Gute Kenntnisse der Landessprache

Vorteile

• 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unseren Restaurants in der Schweiz und in Liechtenstein

• Sunrise-Abos zu einem reduzierten Preis

• Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten über die Plattform "Corporate Benefits"

• Kostenloser Zugang zur grössten Online-Schulungsbibliothek

descriptionByLocale.it:
Presentazione aziendale

A McDonald’s, ogni turno è una nuova occasione per imparare, fare la differenza e divertirsi insieme! Il nostro team ama lavorare insieme, supportarsi a vicenda e dare ai nostri ospiti e equipaggio grandi momenti. Se siete alla ricerca di un lavoro energico, sociale e pieno di opportunità, siete al posto giusto con noi!

Descrizione del lavoro

Come coordinatore del turno, sei la persona di contatto centrale per la tua squadra e i nostri ospiti. Organizza e guida il tuo turno, assicurarsi che funzioni senza problemi e che tutti si sentano comodi e sicuri. Tu motiva il tuo equipaggio, prendili ovunque e porta energia positiva ad ogni turno. Si guida per esempio, concentrandosi sulla sicurezza alimentare, qualità, servizio, pulizia e igiene, e sempre pronto per allenare e sostenere il vostro team.

Principali compiti

• Organizzare e gestire il tuo turno per un'esperienza di ristorante fluida

• Garantire un ambiente sicuro e accogliente per gli ospiti e il team

• Compliance con elevati standard di qualità, servizio, pulizia e igiene

• Sostenere il team in momenti frenetici – sia in cucina, al bancone o al ristorante

• Promuovere il lavoro di squadra e la motivazione dell'equipaggio

• Comunicazione aperta e gestione dei conflitti con empatia e rispetto

• Utilizzo di strumenti di pianificazione e gestione (checkout, ordini, inventario)

• Sostegno alle iniziative di formazione e sviluppo

Requisiti

• Personalità affidabile, responsabile e positiva

• Godetevi il lavoro con le persone e in una squadra

• Comunicazione aperta, empatica e rispettosa

• Proattivo, fantasioso e disposto ad imparare

• Analitica e tecnica

• Resiliente, flessibile e ottimista

• Buona conoscenza della lingua nazionale

Vantaggi

• Ore lavorative flessibili per un buon equilibrio di vita lavorativa

• Team multiculturale e di supporto

• Opportunità di formazione e di formazione – molti manager iniziano come coordinatore del turno!

• Remunerazione e condizioni di lavoro secondo le disposizioni del contratto collettivo di lavoro (L-GAV)

• 50% di sconto sui nostri prodotti nei nostri ristoranti in Svizzera e Liechtenstein

• Abbonamenti Sunrise ad un prezzo ridotto

• Accesso agli sconti esclusivi tramite la piattaforma "Corporate Benefits"

• Vacanze aggiuntive offerte per oltre 50s

• Accesso gratuito alla più grande biblioteca di formazione online

Applicazione

Pronto a portare il raggio nella squadra? Applicare ora e iniziare il vostro viaggio al McDonald’s. Non vediamo l'ora di vederti!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Company presentation

At McDonald’s, every shift is a new chance to learn, make a difference and have fun together! Our team loves working together, supporting each other and giving our guests and crew great moments. If you are looking for a job that is energetic, social and full of opportunities, you are at the right place with us!

Job description

As a shift coordinator, you are the central contact person for your team and our guests. You organize and lead your shift, ensure that it runs smoothly and that everyone feels comfortable and safe. You motivate your crew, grab them everywhere and bring positive energy to every shift. You lead by example, focusing on food safety, quality, service, cleanliness and hygiene, and always ready to coach and support your team.

Main tasks

• Organizing and managing your shift for a smooth restaurant experience

• Ensuring a safe and welcoming environment for guests and team

• Compliance with high standards of quality, service, cleanliness and hygiene

• Support the team in hectic moments – whether in the kitchen, at the counter or in the restaurant

• Promoting teamwork and crew motivation

• Open communication and conflict management with empathy and respect

• Use of planning and management tools (checkouts, orders, inventory)

• Support for training and development initiatives

Requirements

• Reliable, responsible and positive personality

• Enjoy working with people and in a team

• Open, empathetic and respectful communication

• Proactive, imaginative and willing to learn

• Analytical and technically affine

• Resilient, flexible and optimistic

• Good knowledge of the national language

Benefits

• Flexible working hours for a good work-life balance

• Multicultural, supportive team

• Training and further education opportunities – many managers start as shift coordinator!

• Remuneration and working conditions in accordance with the provisions of the collective employment contract (L-GAV)

• 50% discount on our products in our restaurants in Switzerland and Liechtenstein

• Sunrise subscriptions at a reduced price

• Access to exclusive discounts via the "Corporate Benefits" platform

• Additional holidays offered for over 50s

• Free access to the largest online training library

Application

Ready to bring your beam into the team? Apply now and start your journey at McDonald’s. We look forward to seeing you!
